construct_encoders: build a Haiku linear encoder for graph node or edge features with configurable hidden dimension and initializer
preprocess: preprocess a graph data point by expanding pointer indices to one-hot vectors before encoding
accum_adj_mat: accumulate a graph adjacency matrix from node pointer or edge mask data points
accum_edge_fts: encode and accumulate edge features from node or edge data points using Haiku encoders
accum_node_fts: encode and accumulate node features from non-pointer node or graph pointer data points
